analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is missing validation/normalization of double-bond stereo control atoms when CXSMILES 'c/t/u' stereo annotations are applied. parse_doublebond_stereo() calls Chirality::detail::setStereoanyFromSquiggleBond(), which ends up setting Bond::setStereoAtoms() with indices that can include one endpoint of the double bond itself (or otherwise invalid controlling-neighbor assumptions). Later canonicalization in makeBondHolder() unconditionally reads bond->getStereoAtoms()[0] and [1] and treats them as valid neighboring control atoms, causing out-of-bounds access in the canon_atom vector (container-overflow). Crash manifests in new_canon.cpp:410, but unsafe state is introduced earlier in setStereoanyFromSquiggleBond().
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a SMILES/CXSMILES input that causes parse_doublebond_stereo() (CXSmilesOps.cpp) to mark a bond as stereo-any/cis/trans and populate stereo atoms inconsistently (e.g., malformed/edge-case squiggle stereo context as in provided PoC). During subsequent sanitize/removeHs -> cleanUpOrganometallics -> rankMolAtoms -> initCanonAtoms, makeBondHolder() processes that bond with includeChirality=true and dereferences stereo atom indices without checking size/valid-neighbor constraints, leading to container-overflow read.
